requirements.quote:
+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                   MADNAME                     /
    /                                               /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+

where:

MADNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a host which has a mail
                agent for the domain which should be able to deliver
                mail for the domain.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding an MD resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent its RDATA as one MADNAME field encoded as a domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: The MD RDATA encoder and decoder can be inspected for the single domain-name field shown in the format.

requirements.quote:
MADNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a host which has a mail
                agent for the domain which should be able to deliver
                mail for the domain.
requirements.condition: When interpreting the MADNAME field of an MD resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret MADNAME as the name of a host that has a mail agent for the domain.
requirements.why_checkable: The record representation and mail-routing interpretation can be checked for the meaning assigned to MADNAME.

requirements.quote:
MD records cause additional section processing which looks up an A type
record corresponding to MADNAME.
requirements.condition: When processing an MD record for a DNS response.
requirements.required_behavior: Trigger additional-section processing that looks up an A record corresponding to MADNAME.
requirements.why_checkable: An MD response fixture can establish whether additional-section processing performs an A lookup using MADNAME.

requirements.quote:
the new scheme.  The recommended policy for dealing with MD RRs found in
a master file is to reject them, or to convert them to MX RRs with a
preference of 0.
requirements.condition: When an MD resource record is found in a master file, under the recommended policy.
requirements.required_behavior: It is recommended to reject the MD record or convert it to an MX record.
requirements.why_checkable: Master-file loading can be checked for either recommended handling alternative; this recommendation does not require all implementations to reject or convert.

requirements.quote:
the new scheme.  The recommended policy for dealing with MD RRs found in
a master file is to reject them, or to convert them to MX RRs with a
preference of 0.
requirements.condition: When following the recommended master-file policy by converting an MD resource record to MX.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the converted MX record preference to 0, as part of the recommended policy.
requirements.why_checkable: The preference value in the converted MX record can be inspected; applicability is limited to the recommended conversion policy.
